conviction_note: The findings net to +0.8 after the lessons pass. The scaled number is -0.2 (p_up 48 x abs 5.0). They disagree in sign because the quarter itself very probably prints weak. Q3 2026 saw CSI 300 -12.5% and ChiNext -27.8%, against RMB239m of H1 carry that management said not to annualise, and CMB's fund-distribution income fell 18.5% QoQ. But the quarterly consensus cannot be sourced, so the findings that depend on it are capped small. Management guided H2 down (FY operating margin ~30% after 36.3% in H1). The stock is -27% since the Q2 print, trades near its cash, and the stock's reaction to the payout question is the bigger swing; its sign is unknown. The negative lean survives in p_up and is cut back in the findings.
bar: Unsourced at the quarterly level. The only consensus found is FY2026 (4 analysts, S&P Global via stockanalysis.com, data updated 2026-11-10): revenue RMB2.53bn (range 2.3-2.7bn), net income RMB653.3m, operating income RMB789.5m, DPS RMB10.52 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noah/forecast/). Less H1 actuals (revenue RMB1,246m; GAAP NI 124.7+232.2=356.9m), it implies H2 revenue ~RMB1.28bn, ~RMB642m a quarter, and NI ~RMB148m a quarter. Chartmill shows FY2026 EPS 9.85 (6 analysts, 2026-10-24) per a search snippet. Benzinga showed no quarterly EPS estimate (Q2 revenue estimate was $85.1M). Earnings Whispers shows no whisper. The company gives no quarterly guide; its only guide is FY operating margin 'about 30%' (Q2 call, 2026-08-25). Every finding that depends on the bar is capped small.

expectations.real_bar: The quarter is already expected to be weak (stock -27% since Q2, at roughly its cash). To rise, the call has to firm up the capital return, meaning a FY2026 payout at least comparable to RMB612m or a new buyback, while Q3 revenue does not fall far below the ~RMB530-560m that management's ~30% FY margin guide implies.

next_guide.street_next_quarter: not found (no Q4 2026 quarterly estimate found; FY implies H2 revenue ~RMB1.28bn)
next_guide.street_full_year: FY2026 revenue RMB2.53bn, net income RMB653.3m, operating income RMB789.5m, DPS RMB10.52 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noah/forecast/, updated 2026-11-10)
next_guide.company_current_guide: No revenue guide. FY2026 operating margin 'about 30%' and 'quarterly results may fluctuate with product mix and expense timing' (Q2 call 2026-08-25, https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640). Dividend: 'not decided on exactly the portion or ratio of the future dividend' but 'at least a comparable level of shareholder returns' (same call).
next_guide.basis: The ~30% FY margin guide already implies an H2 margin of ~24% after H1's 36.3%, which leaves room for a weak Q3. Cost cuts continue (H1 costs -11.6%, headcount -17%), so a reiteration is more likely than a cut. The street FY revenue of RMB2.53bn looks high against Q3 conditions, so analyst estimates rather than company guidance are more likely to move.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 was a sharp A-share drawdown: CSI 300 -12.49%, ChiNext -27.80%, STAR 50 -30.70%, Shanghai Composite -6.16% for the quarter. Noah's performance-based income was RMB100.7m in Q1 and RMB139.4m in Q2, 'driven mainly by mainland private secondary products' and recognised on a cash basis, and is likely to fall back toward Q3 2025's RMB21.8m. Mainland private secondary distribution (RMB2.8bn in Q2, already -48% QoQ) likely falls further. On my component build, Q3 revenue is ~RMB520-560m against the ~RMB642m a quarter implied by the FY street number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's carry-driven +7.4% revenue beat bought -0.68% the next day and then drifted -27%, so this name has not paid for carry. Q1's 5.4% revenue miss: reaction not found.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -27% since Q2 and an index drawdown is public. But the FY street revenue of RMB2.53bn (updated 2026-11-10) still implies H2 near H1's carry-inflated run-rate. If the market had fully priced a carry collapse, the FY consensus would sit near the low estimate (RMB2.3bn), not the mean.
findings.independence: SCMP independently reports CSI 300 -12% and STAR 50 -31% in Q3 (https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3369517/stock-losses-bond-bets-5-figures-investors-are-watching-china). The carry figures and the 'mainly mainland private secondary' attribution come from Noah's own Q1 and Q2 6-Ks (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001499543/000110465926066984/tm2615616d1_ex99-1.htm). This is macro-to-company transmission that the company has not confirmed for Q3, so it is a proxy. It shares its conclusion (revenue below the street) with the consensus_bar finding, but rests on a different fact.

findings.finding: China Merchants Bank's Q3 2026 fund-distribution (代理基金) income was ~RMB1.55bn, -10.4% YoY and -18.5% QoQ, its first simultaneous YoY and QoQ decline in recent years. Ping An Bank's personal fund-distribution income fell 10.71% QoQ (+18.2% YoY). The mainland channel Noah sells mutual funds and private products through weakened in the same quarter.
findings.link: Same product and channel. CMB's private bank and Noah both distribute mutual funds and private securities products to mainland HNW clients. Noah's mainland public securities segment was RMB206.5m, 33% of Q2 revenue, and mainland mutual-fund transaction value was RMB5.5bn in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced history of NOAH reacting to the distribution-volume line specifically. Q2's flat transaction value (RMB17.1bn) came with a -0.68% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Bank Q3 fee detail is a Chinese-language A-share story published 2026-11-11 and is unlikely to be read into a $4m-a-day ADR with four analysts. If it had been, the FY revenue consensus would have moved down from RMB2.53bn after the 2026-11-10 update.
findings.independence: Points the same way as the index drawdown (https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20261001/c680429794.shtml) but is a different, company-reported series. It is a peer, not a counterparty, and Noah's mix leans more to private products than CMB's, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: The FY2026 street figures (revenue RMB2.53bn, NI RMB653m, OI RMB789.5m; 4 analysts, updated 2026-11-10) imply H2 revenue ~RMB1.28bn, at or above H1's RMB1.246bn. H1 contained RMB239m of carry that management said 'should not be annualized off any single quarter' and that it 'does not accrue or forecast'. The street H2 therefore looks high against the company's own caution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 revenue missed by 5.4% and Q2 beat by 7.4% (Benzinga snippet). The only sourced reaction is Q2's -0.68%.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is one aggregator's FY average with no quarterly split, possibly stale. The market may already hold a lower bar than this consensus (stock -27%), which is why the finding is capped small.
findings.independence: Management's 'do not annualise carry' statement is from the Q2 call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640). This finding shares its conclusion with the macro finding above but rests on the consensus arithmetic, not on the index move.

findings.finding: Management already guided H2 down. After H1's 36.3% operating margin, the CFO said 'We expect our full-year operating margin to remain at a healthy level, about 30%' and that 'quarterly results may fluctuate'. That implies an H2 operating margin of ~24%, so a weak Q3 (~RMB130m OI on ~RMB530-560m revenue) lands inside what the company told the market.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide was given on the Q2 call; the stock fell -0.68% that day and -27% after, consistent with the market taking the H2 step-down on board.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced, which is the point: it offsets the negative quarter findings. If the market had NOT taken the guided H2 step-down on board, the stock would not have drifted -27% into a print it has a guide for.
findings.independence: The H1 operating margin of 36.3% is from the Q2 6-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001499543/000110465926100838/tm2623683d2_ex99-1.htm). It shares the call transcript with the capital-return finding.

findings.finding: Noah has paid 100% of net income for three straight years: the FY2025 final plus special dividend was RMB612m, $1.31 per ADS, about 21% of today's $6.30 spot, and was paid in August 2026. On the Q2 call the CFO said 'we have not decided on exactly the portion or ratio of the future dividend' but 'will be able to sustain at least a comparable level of shareholder returns'. H1 2026 non-GAAP NI was already RMB371.9m, 61% of FY2025's RMB611.9m. Any firming of the payout on this call lands on a stock that has fallen 27% since that hedge.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 'not decided' remark on 2026-08-25 was followed by a -27.2% drift (Earnings Whispers). The FY2025 dividend announcement (2026-03-24) reaction was not found.
findings.why_not_priced: A stock yielding ~20% on the trailing payout and trading near cash is pricing a payout cut. If the market believed 'at least comparable', the yield would not be ~20%. The sign depends on the call's wording, hence the wide range.
findings.independence: The dividend amounts and the US$0.655 + US$0.655 per ADS come from the company's payment notice (https://finviz.com/news/361237/noah-holdings-limited-announces-results-of-annual-general-meeting-and-payment-of-final-dividend-and-special-dividend). The 50% Corporate Actions Budget policy and the FY2025 RMB306m + RMB306m are confirmed by search results on the policy documents. The formal FY2026 decision is in March 2027 (outside the window); only the commentary is in the window.

findings.finding: The US$50m share repurchase program, authorised 2024-08-28/29 with a two-year term, expired around late August 2026. About $34m (3.2m+ ADS) was used per the Q2 call, and no renewal was found. The stock trades near cash: RMB4,322.7m ($637m) of cash at 2026-06-30, ~RMB5.0bn including short-term investments, no interest-bearing debt, against ~$430m of market value at $6.30. A new program could come with the Q3 release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2024 program was announced 2024-08-29 alongside Q2 2024 results; its reaction was not found. The Q3 2025 release announced no buyback.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing announces it, so a probability-weighted chance of a new program is not in a price that sits at cash. Low probability, because last year's Q3 release carried none, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Program usage is from the Q2 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640); cash is from the Q2 6-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001499543/000110465926100838/tm2623683d2_ex99-1.htm).

findings.finding: Expectations are already low. The stock has fallen 27.2% since the 2026-08-25 Q2 release, sits 48.9% below its 52-week high and 3.1% above its low, -8.3% over 20 days, 23% below the lowest analyst target ($8.21), and below its cash and short-term investments. A weak Q3 is the base case the price holds.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the -27% drift there is no sourced example of how this name reacts to a weak print from a washed-out base. Q2 from a higher base: -0.68%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the priced state itself, filed because it sets how much of the quarter's weakness the print can still deliver. If the market expected a good Q3, the stock would sit nearer the $10 mean target.
findings.independence: Baseline tape (run-up, distance from the 52-week range) and analyst targets from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noah/forecast/.

findings.finding: J.P. Morgan (Peter Zhang) kept Hold and cut its target from $9.70 to $8.20 on 2026-11-10, two weeks before the print. Citi cut from $13 to $12 on 2026-09-03. At least part of the sell side marked the quarter down ahead of time.
findings.why_not_priced: It is in the wire, so it is priced as a lower bar. It is filed because it lowers the effective bar below the stale FY consensus.
findings.independence: Shares the stockanalysis page with the consensus_bar finding.

findings.finding: Below-the-line items are likely to swing. Q2 had a RMB41.8m fair-value gain on equity securities and a RMB7.7m litigation-provision reversal; Q1 had a RMB65.3m loss from equity in affiliates. With STAR 50 -30.7% in Q3, a mark-to-market loss is more likely than a gain. Legacy contingent liabilities were RMB455m at June 30 with >80% of affected clients accepting the settlement, which could produce further reversals.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1's mark-to-market-driven non-GAAP decline of -20.7% was described by management as RMB216.4m ex-item; reaction not found.
findings.why_not_priced: Remeasurements are not modelled by a four-analyst consensus. There is no path to the guide or the dividend beyond a slightly lower NI base, so it is sized as a fraction.
findings.independence: The Q2 gain and reversal and the RMB455m contingent liabilities are from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001499543/000110465926100838/tm2623683d2_ex99-1.htm and the Q2 call. The direction is inferred from the index drawdown (same source as the macro finding).

findings.finding: International wealth management keeps shrinking: Q2 revenue RMB88.9m, -31.3% YoY, with international RMs down to 56 (vs 107) per the release text. The Q3 2025 comparable is RMB146.2m, so another steep YoY decline in that line is likely. International AUM is rising (RMB43.8bn, US$6.5bn, +11.7%) and Singapore reached monthly profitability in July.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's -31% overseas WM decline coincided with a -0.68% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is a known trend in the company's own filings. Filed because the Q3 2025 comparable (RMB146.2m, https://finviz.com/news/239078/noah-holdings-limited-announces-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-third-quarter-of-2025) makes the headline YoY ugly. Net of the rest: international AM (RMB106m) and the rising AUM partly offset it.
findings.independence: The overseas AUM and Singapore figures are from the Q2 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640).

findings.finding: Mainland private securities issuance was strong through Q3. 12,022 private securities products were registered in the first three quarters (+34.05% YoY, 49% quant), and AMAC's September data show 1,058 new securities private funds. Futures and derivatives strategies returned +6.39% YTD against +1.92% for equity strategies. This partly offsets the carry and distribution negative if Noah's shelf leans quant.
findings.why_not_priced: Industry registration data is not followed for an ADR. Noah's own private secondary volume fell 48% QoQ in Q2 despite strong industry issuance, so transmission is weak and it is sized small.
findings.independence: The YTD-by-strategy performance (+2.37% overall, 56.7% of products positive) is from search results citing 私募排排网; the 100-billion-manager average of +7.07% YTD is from https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202610153897052877.html. Some private products earned positive returns despite the index drawdown, which tempers the macro finding.

findings.finding: The only management event inside the quarter found was the 2026 Global Investor Summit in Hong Kong ('The Year of Realization'). It gave no AUM, client, target or guidance figures; it restated the three-platform strategy (ARK, Olive, Glory) and the use of AI.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing quantitative to price. It is filed so the absence of a mid-quarter reaffirmation is recorded.

baseline_tension: There is no skew and no implied move to cut against. The negative quarter evidence agrees with the -8.3% 20-day run-up and the -27% drift since Q2, so it is largely in the price. The capital-return and low-expectations items cut against that run-up.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (unsourced bar): the quarterly consensus is not sourceable, so the findings that depend on it are capped smaller. Macro carry finding -1.2 -> -0.9; consensus_bar finding -0.8 -> -0.5.
Rule 5 (a proxy is filed small): the CMB peer finding -0.7 -> -0.5; the index-drawdown transmission is marked as a proxy in independence.
Rule 1 (a fact is not a reaction): Q2's +7.4% beat bought -0.68%, so the reaction is damped and p_up moved from 47 to 48.
Rule 8 and the core (abs_move never shrunk for uncertainty): abs_move kept at 5.0 against the baseline's 0.68 median, which is built from non-earnings 6-Ks.
Last section (untrustworthy FPI history): only the 2026-08-25 amc row was kept as a real print; the rest of the baseline history was not used as a base rate.

Rules 3 and 7 checked: no finding contradicts another (a weak Q3 below the street and a weak Q3 inside management's ~30% FY margin guide can both be true); short interest looked up, at 0.48% not crowded; nothing changed.
